_about: cc-P101: the Shard Console's Websites tab reads this file. One entry per site. When a site moves (P89 H3, the move to Haven), change it here, not in the console. No key, password or token ever goes in this file: Haven is reached with Chase's own SSH key (agent or ~/.ssh), and NPM's login stays in his password manager.

haven._ssh: From D:\UO\haven-migration\Deploy-Website.ps1 and the other Haven scripts there.

npm._npm: NPM's admin page listens only on Haven's own 127.0.0.1:81 (haven-proxy-fix.sh step 2, proxy-discovery.txt line 278), so it is reached through an SSH tunnel, as Haven-Website-Runbook.original.md step 3 says: ssh -N -L 8081:localhost:81 chase@192.168.1.61, then http://localhost:8081.

sites.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
sites._check: The admin page is only reachable through the tunnel, so the light checks NPM's proxy port on Haven instead: any answer means NPM is up.

website.what: copies the website page, its images and the intro video from docker\website\html to Haven (scp, then chmod)

wiki-macros.what: rebuilds the wiki's Macros pages from the TazUO Legion scripts and pushes them to Haven

_deploySlots.haven-ops: P89 H3: Deploy-HavenOps.ps1 (the ops pages on Haven). Not written yet. When it exists, add "haven-ops": { "script": "D:\\UO\\haven-migration\\Deploy-HavenOps.ps1", "what": "..." } to deploys and "deploy": "haven-ops" to its site.
_deploySlots._notListed: Haven-Wiki-Update.ps1 (updates the DokuWiki container; the wiki is down about a minute) and Haven-Website-Deploy.ps1 (the first-time setup) are deliberately not deploys here.
